title: Renewal, Renewal Changes and Expiry of Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP)
content:
**Renewal date.** The renewal date of a Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) subscription is the day after its term end date.

**Renewal with auto-renew on.** A subscription whose auto-renew is on renews on the renewal date into a new term of the scheduled renewal term. When no change is scheduled, the new term keeps the current term. The new term carries the scheduled renewal quantity, or the quantity held at term end when no quantity is scheduled. The difference from the quantity held is posted on the renewal date as a renewal increase or a renewal reduction. A subscription that is suspended on the renewal date renews at the quantity it holds, and any scheduled increase is dropped.

**Renewal price.** The renewal term is priced from the current price list for the plan, term and billing frequency under the purchase pricing terms, as the plan's price-at-renewal basis says. It is not priced from the expiring price. A new cancellation window opens.

**Cutoff for renewal changes.** Scheduled renewal changes must be saved no later than the plan's renewal change cutoff, counted in calendar days before the renewal date. The cutoff is the renewal date minus that number of calendar days, and a change saved on the cutoff date itself is in time. A change saved after the cutoff applies only to the renewal after next. The renewal date is read from the subscription's term end date in the system record.

**Expiry with auto-renew off.** A subscription whose auto-renew is off expires on the renewal date. Users keep access for the plan's access period after expiry. After that, only administrators can reach the data for the plan's retention period, and then the data is deleted. Buying a new subscription of the same plan within those periods restores access.

**Status gate.** Renewal settings may be changed only while the subscription status is active or suspended.

## Cutoff boundary (hypothetical dates, a cutoff of 1 calendar day)

| Term end date | Renewal date | Cutoff date | Change saved on | Applies to |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30 June | 1 July | 30 June | 29 June | the coming renewal |
| 30 June | 1 July | 30 June | 30 June | the coming renewal. The cutoff date itself is in time. |
| 30 June | 1 July | 30 June | 1 July | the renewal after next |

## Renewal quantity (hypothetical)

A subscription holds 40 licenses at term end, with 32 scheduled for renewal. It renews at 32, and a renewal reduction of 8 is posted on the renewal date. If 45 had been scheduled and the subscription were suspended on the renewal date, it would renew at 40, because the scheduled increase is dropped.
